# CLI Interface Contract: Copy-SpecKit.ps1

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: 8eb724b4-5309-47ce-817f-68e0bf6b32fa | Date: 2026-01-27 -->

## Script Signature

```powershell
Copy-SpecKit.ps1
    -Destination <string>          # [Mandatory] Target project directory
    [-Source <string>]             # Override source (default: repo containing script)
    [-Preview]                     # Dry-run mode, no filesystem changes
    [-Force]                       # Overwrite existing files at destination
    [-IncludeDomains <string[]>]   # Domain modules to include (e.g., "umbraco","breezsdk")
    [-PassThru]                    # Return CopyResult object for pipeline usage
    [-Verbose]                     # Detailed operation logging (built-in)
    [-WhatIf]                      # PowerShell built-in confirmation (via SupportsShouldProcess)
```

## Parameters

### -Destination (Mandatory)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Type | `string` |
| Mandatory | Yes |
| Position | 0 (positional) |
| Pipeline | No |
| Validation | Must be a valid filesystem path. Created if non-existent. |
| FR | FR-002 |

### -Source (Optional)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Type | `string` |
| Mandatory | No |
| Default | Repository root containing the script (`$PSScriptRoot/../../..`) |
| Validation | Must exist. Must contain `.claude/` and `.specify/` directories and `CLAUDE.md` file. |
| FR | FR-001, FR-014 |

### -Preview (Optional)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Type | `switch` |
| FR | FR-008 |
| Behavior | Lists all planned operations without executing. Groups by tier. Shows inclusion/exclusion reasons. |

### -Force (Optional)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Type | `switch` |
| FR | FR-012 |
| Behavior | Overwrites existing files at destination. Never deletes files not in manifest. |

### -IncludeDomains (Optional)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Type | `string[]` |
| FR | FR-009, FR-010 |
| Examples | `-IncludeDomains umbraco`, `-IncludeDomains umbraco,breezsdk` |
| Validation | Each domain must exist in source. Unknown domains produce a warning and are skipped. |

### -PassThru (Optional)

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Type | `switch` |
| FR | FR-019 |
| Behavior | Returns a `[PSCustomObject]` CopyResult for pipeline consumption. |

## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning | FR |
|------|---------|-----|
| 0 | Success (all files copied, or preview completed) | FR-018 |
| 1 | Validation error (invalid paths, same src/dest, missing source structure) | FR-018, FR-015, FR-014 |
| 2 | Partial success (files skipped due to conflicts without `-Force`) | FR-018, FR-011 |
| 3 | Filesystem error (permission denied, I/O error) | FR-018 |

### PassThru Output

When `-PassThru` is specified, returns a `[PSCustomObject]` with the CopyResult schema from data-model.md.

## Usage Examples

```powershell
# Basic scaffolding (source defaults to repo root)
.\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\MyNewProject

# Preview what would be copied
.\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\MyNewProject -Preview

# Include Umbraco domain agents
.\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\MyUmbracoProject -IncludeDomains umbraco

# Force overwrite for updating existing project
.\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\ExistingProject -Force

# Pipeline usage
$result = .\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\New -PassThru
$result.FilesCopied
```

## Error Messages

| Scenario | Message | Exit Code |
|----------|---------|-----------|
| Same source/dest | "ERROR: Source and destination paths are the same: {path}" | 1 |
| Missing source structure | "ERROR: Source path does not contain required Spec-Kit structure. Missing: {list}" | 1 |
| Source not found | "ERROR: Source path does not exist: {path}" | 1 |
| Unknown domain | "WARNING: Domain module '{name}' not found in source. Available: {list}" | Continues |
| Permission denied | "ERROR: Cannot write to destination: {path}. Check permissions." | 3 |
| Files skipped | "WARNING: {n} files skipped (already exist). Use -Force to overwrite." | 2 |
